description.value: An fMRI study of habitual emotion acceptance and neural activation during passive viewing of negative and neutral face movies in women with borderline personality disorder and healthy controls.

quotes: In the present functional MRI (fMRI) study, we investigated the neural correlates of habitual emotion acceptance in individuals with BPD.

value: we hypothesized there would be activation changes of the frontolimbic emotion regulation network in the BPD group in response to emotionally negative stimuli.
we particularly expected increased amygdala and insula activation in patients with BPD compared with healthy controls during passive viewing of negative stimuli.
we additionally assumed that reduced acceptance of negative emotions in individuals with BPD would be associated with respective activation changes in the emotion-regulation network.
